name: ai
description: Turborepo shim for the Python Buzrr-AI service. The real project is pyproject.toml.

scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q -e ".[dev]"
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('ai: nothing to build — this service ships as a Docker image (apps/ai/Dockerfile).')"
scripts.lint: node scripts/run.mjs ruff check src alembic tests
scripts.format: node scripts/run.mjs ruff format src alembic tests
